title: Harbor and Postcard
author: Freya Winterbourne
blurb: Marguerite Whitlock, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
